quests.title: Scent on the Wind

dialogue.t: Mmmm! The aroma is coming from Good Hunter!
A thick slice of soft white toast...
Topped with a generous serving of onion slices, lightly caramelized by the toasting... Yum yum!
It's an emergency! We must order ourselves a generous serving of <color=#00E1FFFF>Fisherman's Toast</color> from <color=#00E1FFFF>Good Hunter</color>, pronto!
Good Hunter's Fisherman's Toast is the best!
This might surprise you, but it's actually a classic Mondstadt recipe that anyone can cook.
You can try cooking it yourself if you have the ingredients.
Can {NICKNAME}'s cooking skills surpass that of Good Hunter's?
Why, Paimon would love to be your personal taster!

quests.description: As you walk through Mondstadt, Paimon is attracted by the aroma of food…
